# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary providing authoritative definitions, language resources, word games, and vocabulary tools for students, professionals, and word enthusiasts.

Merriam-Webster offers comprehensive dictionary services including the flagship Collegiate Dictionary (Twelfth Edition), specialized resources like slang dictionaries and student editions, plus interactive word games such as Quordle, Scrabble tools, and daily vocabulary features. Available across web, iOS, and Android platforms with over 300,000 definitions and educational content.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and word lookup
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary (Twelfth Edition)
- Word games (Quordle, Scrabble, Blossom, Octordle)
- Vocabulary building and language learning
- Word of the Day
- Slang and contemporary language
- Grammar and wordplay
- Student and educational resources
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Word finder and Scrabble solver
- Gen Z terms and internet language
- Daily words and calendar features
- Britannica partnership content

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage with 300,000+ definitions, word games, and language resources
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Collegiate Dictionary 12th Edition product page for students & professionals
- [Slang Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Slang dictionary covering trending words, Gen Z terms, and internet language
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Student dictionary and educational games for children's vocabulary building

## Word Games and Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble solver and word game tool for finding matching dictionary words
- [Chatbot Interface](https://www.merriam-webster.com/chatbot): Chatbot interface for dictionary lookups and word games like Quordle
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps including dictionary, Scrabble, and word game downloads

## Daily Vocabulary Features

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary calendar with podcast, email, and social media delivery
